lucee.notes: Since Lucee 7.1, compress/extract functionality moved from core to the Compress extension. Basic zip and gzip support remains available in core using built-in JRE capabilities. Other formats (bzip, bzip2, tar, tbz, tbz2, tgz) require the Compress extension. It is included in the full jar. ([LDEV-5959](https://luceeserver.atlassian.net/browse/LDEV-5959))

name: compress
description: Compress given source to different formats.
syntax: compress( string format, string source, string target, [boolean includeBaseFolder], [string mode] )

params.name: format
params.description:
Compression Format

- bzip
- bzip2
- gzip
- tar
- tar.bz
- tbz (tar bzip)
- tbz2
- tgz (tar gzip)
- tar.gz
- zip

params.name: source
params.description:
source file or directory to compress

**Note:** For gzip & bzip format must use the file path as the source

params.name: target
params.description: name of the target compressed file

params.name: includeBaseFolder
params.description: take the folder or only content of folder
